notes: The μή/τί pair is joined under rule 59's plain-indefinite arm; rule 41 would empty μή only if the second word were itself a negative.
Both the supplied possessive on τοὺς (rule 20 second arm) and the supplied juncture on λέγει (rule 88) are rule 7 helpers, not `added`.
πολλοῦ ὄχλου is anarthrous adjective plus noun, so rule 58 puts the supplied *a* on the noun, discontinuously under rule 15.
